is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus (page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the kdr (L1014S) mutation (page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports a kdr allele (L1014S) frequency of 0.22 in a random sample of 47 An. gambiae s.l. mosquitoes (page 3).

african_field_population.evidence: The mosquitoes were collected from experimental huts in Zeneti village, Muheza District, Tanzania (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut study conducted by the authors (page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Zeneti village, Muheza District, Tanzania (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial ran between June and July of 2011 (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a specific experimental hut trial conducted in 2011.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy of pirimiphos methyl-treated net wall hangings (NWH) in experimental huts in Muheza, Tanzania. It also assessed the kdr (L1014S) resistance marker in a sample of 47 An. gambiae s.l. mosquitoes collected from the huts, finding an allele frequency of 0.22.
